name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.receiver.NotificationBroadcastReceiver
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK runs this receiver when a user taps a notification created by an SDK advertisement. It handles the ad click, sends its follow-up action, and dismisses the notification.
disableEffect: Tapping the SDK's ad notifications will no longer open their follow-up action or record the click.
